create_TarDataset: create a TarDataset instance with tar_urls, tar_sha256, and tar_compression to manage a compressed tar archive dataset
install_TarDataset: install a TarDataset by downloading and extracting the tar archive to the site data path with thread-safe locking
check_TarDataset_installed: check if a TarDataset is installed by calling the installed property that verifies the extraction marker file
create_TarDatasetWithManifest: create a TarDatasetWithManifest instance with manifest_urls and manifest_sha256 to read benchmark URIs from a separate manifest file
iterate_TarDatasetWithManifest_benchmark: iterate over benchmark URIs from a TarDatasetWithManifest by calling benchmark_uris which yields URI strings from the manifest
